KEYSPAN ENERGY DELIVERY NEW ENGLAND 
D.T.E. 05-68 
 
FIRST SET OF INFORMATION REQUESTS OF THE 
ATTORNEY GENERAL TO 
KEYSPAN ENERGY DELIVERY NEW ENGLAND 
 
AG 1-1 
 
 
Date: March 9, 2006 
Respondent:  Elizabeth Arangio 
 
 
Q. 
Refer to the Department’s Order, D.T.E. 01-105, p. 45.  Please provide 
unredacted copies of all written communications between the Company 
and the Department regarding the Enron capacity. 
 
 
A.   
A copy of the Company’s letter to the Department dated April 1, 2003 is 
provided as Attachment AG 1-1.  No other written communications were 
made to the Department.
